25_notesAndComments.notesAndComments:
This is a 5-year multi-tenant industrial NET lease with strong tenant-side improvements over a typical landlord-form template — particularly in Article 14 (Assignment/Subletting). Tenant achieved (a) negotiated reasonableness factors, (b) deemed-consent mechanism, (c) consent fee cap, (d) deletion of recapture right, (e) Permitted Transfers regime including IPO and change-of-control carve-out, (f) 50/50 Net Transfer Premium share AFTER Tenant deductions, (g) full Tenant release on qualifying assignment to $10M+ TNW assignee. Schedule G overrides include the $500,000 TI Allowance trigger structure and the 61-day fully-abated Fixturing Period.

Key LANDLORD-FAVOURABLE retained provisions create asymmetric risk: §17.9 unilateral 6-month sale/demolition termination right; §17.2 relocation right; §6.6(c) Tenant prohibited from contesting Realty Taxes; broad §2.37 Operating Costs definition with no cap.

Blank fields identified (not deemed AutoFail because they are template placeholders within definitions or non-financial deal terms, not within executed financial values): §1(j) Landlord notice address, §2.8 Business Hours bullets, §5.2(c) blank year and per-sf estimate, §2.35 Management Fee election ambiguity, Schedule F Rule 22 parking option not elected, signage template option not specifically elected. None of these affect the AutoFail criteria (parties identified, financial values verbatim+normalized, currency CAD verified, dates ISO 8601, MISSING rate <30%).

Currency confirmed as CAD via: Ontario governing law (§19.5), 'lawful money of Canada at par' (§5.1), HST/Sales Tax references throughout, Ontario corporate registration of both parties, Mississauga, Ontario premises location.

No Indemnifier; no Letter of Credit. Rent Deposit is the sole credit support.

Missing-field rate calculation: across the 25 sections and ~165 actively-extracted fields, approximately 26 fields were tagged MISSING (e.g., Indemnifier subfields, Letter of Credit subfields, NSF fee, OpEx/Tax/Mgmt monthly estimates, parking allocation, Tenant attention line and email, etc.) — yielding ~16% MISSING rate, below the 30% AutoFail threshold.
